resources.string: Unofficial app — not affiliated with Hyundai. Uses the same type of API access as community tools (e.g. bluelinky). Hyundai may change or block this at any time. Use at your own risk.

1. Open Tasker → Tasks → add a task.
2. Add action: System → Send Intent.
3. Action: com.hyundaicompanion.bluelinktasker.REMOTE_COMMAND
4. Cat: Default
5. Mime Type: (empty)
6. Package: com.hyundaicompanion.bluelinktasker
7. Class: com.hyundaicompanion.bluelinktasker.CommandReceiver
8. Target: Broadcast Receiver

Enter these three extras for remote start, one per Extra field.
command:start
secret:PASTE_YOUR_SECRET_HERE
start_options:{"temp":70,"duration":10,"climate":true,"defrost":false,"heated":0,"driverSeat":0,"passengerSeat":0,"rearLeftSeat":0,"rearRightSeat":0}

For a remote start using all saved settings, enter only command and secret. Missing or invalid JSON fields use their saved values. Temperature is 60–90 °F, duration is 1–30 minutes, heated is 0–3, and seat levels are 0–8.

For unlock, lock, or stop, use a separate task with the corresponding command and your secret.
Set a Tasker secret in Account setup first.
